title: Gentle Shoulder Vibration
summary: The palms stay in contact with the shoulder muscles while creating a small, gentle rhythmic vibration without percussion.
goal: Add a brief, gentle rhythmic technique before finishing work on the shoulder girdle.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of gentle vibration over the upper shoulders.
startingPosition: The palms rest loosely on the soft tissues of the upper shoulders, with the hands and forearms relaxed.
instructions: Place the palms on the soft upper shoulder tissues.
Create a small, rapid vibration through the palms.
Do not turn the movement into percussion or strong shaking.
Stop smoothly after a few seconds.
direction: Fine vibration is transmitted through the palms into the soft shoulder tissues.
tips: Let the movement come from relaxed hands.
mistakes: Shaking the head and neck strongly.
Continuing vibration when it causes discomfort.
warning: Avoid vibration with acute pain, recent injury, marked dizziness, or whenever the movement triggers unpleasant symptoms.
telegramCaption: Brief, gentle vibration through the palms over the upper shoulders.
